title: Open YouTube Shorts in the regular player
question: How do I watch YouTube Shorts in the regular video player?
answer: YouTube has no setting that opens Shorts in the normal player, but every Short is also a regular video: change /shorts/ in the address to /watch?v= and keep the video ID. The usermods script on this page does that for you. When a youtube.com/shorts/ link loads, or you click a Short in a feed or search results, it opens the same video on the regular watch page, with the seek bar, playback speed, quality menu and comments.
prompt: Open YouTube Shorts in the normal video player instead of the Shorts player.
details:
The script runs before the page draws. On a direct load of a `/shorts/<id>` URL (a pasted link, a new tab, a reload) it replaces the address with `/watch?v=<id>`, so the Shorts URL does not stay in your history and Back works normally. Inside YouTube, a plain click on a Shorts link loads the watch page instead; a middle click or Ctrl/Cmd-click opens a new tab, which then redirects on load.

The check loads a Shorts URL directly and confirms the watch page plays the same video ID. The click path is not covered by the check. Shorts shelves in feeds stay visible; to hide them, use the Hide YouTube Shorts script.

alternatives.title: Edit the URL by hand
alternatives.body: Replace `/shorts/` with `/watch?v=` in the address bar. `youtube.com/shorts/bkSNwyl7iHE` becomes `youtube.com/watch?v=bkSNwyl7iHE`.

evidence.note: YouTube Shorts To Normal Video (4071 total installs)

check.baseline: (() => { const s = document.querySelector("ytd-shorts"); return location.pathname === "/shorts/bkSNwyl7iHE" && !!s && s.checkVisibility(); })()
check.expect: (() => { const w = document.querySelector("ytd-watch-flexy"); const s = document.querySelector("ytd-shorts"); return location.pathname === "/watch" && new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("v") === "bkSNwyl7iHE" && !!w && w.checkVisibility() && !(s && s.checkVisibility()); })()
check.intact: (() => { const v = document.querySelector("#movie_player video"); const t = document.querySelector("ytd-watch-metadata h1"); return !!v && v.checkVisibility() && !!t && t.checkVisibility() && t.textContent.trim().length > 0; })()
